ruleName: Deliberately Changing Club's Performance Characteristics During Round
title: Adjusting Your Driver During the Round
question: Halfway through your round, you decide to increase the loft of your adjustable driver using the manufacturer's adjustment tool to help get the ball higher in the air. Is this allowed?

choices.text: Yes. You may adjust your clubs at any time during the round.
No. Deliberately changing the playing characteristics of a club during a round is not allowed.
Yes, provided you only change the loft once.

explanation: If a club has adjustable features, such as an adjustable loft or lie, those settings must not be changed during a round. Altering the club's playing characteristics after the round has started is a breach of the Rules. You may only adjust the club before the round begins. If a club is damaged during normal play, it may be repaired or replaced in certain circumstances, but you cannot use the adjustment mechanism to change how the club is designed to play. (Rule 4.1a(3))
